description: Bridge Crack Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Crack Detection Research Team. This dataset contains crack images and their corresponding annotations collected from the wooden structural components of the Lingyan Wind and Rain Bridge, located in Gantang River Park, Lingchuan County, Guilin City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
